response: The function implements the classic O(m·n·p) matrix‑multiplication algorithm: it iterates over each row i of A, each column j of B, and the shared dimension k, accumulating the sum ∑ₖ A[i][k]·B[k][j] into result[i][j]. This follows the definition of the product of an m×n matrix A and an n×p matrix B, yielding an m×p matrix.
